content: Semantics of attribute NotAvailableValueSpecifica- tion . defaultPattern The usage of NotAvailableValueSpecification ex- plicitly defines that no specific initialization value shall be defined for an optional ele- ment. The memory area occupied by the NotAvailableValueSpecification shall how- ever be filled with a deterministic pattern during initialization. The content of defaultPattern shall be used to fill the gap in the memory occupied by an optional element with NotAvailableValueSpecification initialization.
